scenarios.scenario_abstract: With a total budget of one hundred dollars for new computer glasses, [X] narrows the frame by prescription needs, all-day comfort, facial features, and how visible or unobtrusive its color should look during screen use.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 在一百美元总预算内购买新的电脑眼镜时，[X]会结合处方需求、全天舒适度、脸型与面部特征，以及希望镜框颜色在屏幕使用时多显眼或多低调来缩小选择。
examples: comparing a dark frame with a visually receding clear or pale option
checking whether an earth-toned or patterned-looking color still feels appropriate for daily computer use
keeping enough budget for lenses and anti-reflective treatment instead of choosing color in isolation

scenarios.scenario_abstract: Before an afternoon optometrist appointment to try Cartier glasses, [X] chooses a polished cold-weather outfit and plans to compare candidate frames against [X]'s face, wool coat, shop lighting, and daylight without assuming the most luxurious-looking option will suit every context.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 准备下午去验光店试戴 Cartier 眼镜时，[X]先选好一套利落的寒冷天气穿搭，并计划把候选镜框分别放在自己的脸部、羊毛大衣、店内灯光和自然光下比较，而不是默认最显奢华的选项就适合所有情境。
examples: checking neutral, earth, metallic, bright, and transparent-looking frames under two light sources
keeping the neckline and nearby outfit visually quiet so the face comparison remains readable
treating the appointment as a try-on rather than claiming a frame has already been bought

scenarios.scenario_abstract: While building a personal Tracer cosplay, [X] selects pilot or welding goggles to modify and attach to the character's headpiece, then decides how the visible frame color can support recognition without competing with the lenses, jacket, and illuminated prop.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 在制作个人版 Tracer cosplay 时，[X]选定要改装并连接到角色头饰上的飞行员或焊接护目镜，并需要判断可见镜框的颜色怎样帮助角色辨识，同时不与镜片、夹克和发光道具争抢视觉重点。
examples: preserving the selected goggles while changing only their visible frame finish
using a restrained dark or metallic edge when the surrounding props already carry strong color
testing a more visible frame only when it still reads as part of the same character build

scenarios.scenario_abstract: For an open-air R&B stadium concert, [X] includes sunglasses in a comfortable streetwear outfit that must work for a daylight arrival, photographs, strict bag limits, hours of movement, and a dark exit after the show.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 参加露天 R&B 体育场演唱会时，[X]会把太阳镜纳入舒适的街头穿搭；镜框颜色需要兼顾白天入场、拍照、严格包袋限制、数小时活动和散场后的昏暗环境。
examples: choosing whether the frame should disappear into the outfit or become its main accent
checking how the frame reads in both daylight photos and the venue's darker visual environment
keeping the eyewear easy to carry once it is no longer needed after sunset

scenarios.scenario_abstract: While organizing an outdoor golf-group luncheon, [X] incorporates sunglasses into a playful dress theme and photo setup for twenty-five adult guests, balancing individual expression with faces that remain coherent and readable in group pictures.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 组织一场户外高尔夫球友午宴时，[X]会把太阳镜纳入 25 位成年客人的趣味着装主题和拍照环节，在个体表达与集体照片中清晰、协调的面部呈现之间取舍。
examples: letting guests interpret one theme through different neutral, vivid, metallic, or translucent frames
avoiding a frame color that overwhelms faces in a large group photograph
keeping the eyewear playful without requiring every guest to buy an identical pair

scenarios.scenario_abstract: While preparing a polished yet comfortable wardrobe for an Italian summer trip, [X] chooses one sunglasses frame color that works near the face through city walks, church visits, coastal heat, dinners, and repeated travel photographs.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 为意大利夏季行程准备既精致又舒适的衣橱时，[X]会选择一种能与面部和服装协调的太阳镜镜框颜色，使其能够贯穿城市步行、教堂参观、海岸炎热、晚餐和反复拍照。
examples: checking the frame against both light daytime clothes and the slightly dressier dinner layer
deciding whether a neutral, earth, metallic, bright, or transparent-looking edge travels most easily
keeping sustainability and EU shopping access as purchase constraints rather than treating them as colors

scenarios.scenario_abstract: While planning a budget-friendly wedding with a partner, [X] considers adding a children's photo area with sunglasses, hats, and scarves, evaluating frame colors that children can distinguish, enjoy, and combine without making family photographs visually chaotic.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 与伴侣筹备低成本婚礼时，[X]考虑增设一个包含太阳镜、帽子和围巾的儿童拍照区，并评估哪些镜框颜色既便于孩子辨认和自由组合，又不会让家庭照片显得杂乱。
examples: using visible color differences so several children can keep track of chosen props
mixing quiet and playful frames while preserving a coherent wedding photo background
selecting reusable props rather than assigning one exact pair to one child

scenarios.scenario_abstract: After giving a friend sunglasses for a birthday because the friend likes expressing himself through fashion, [X] uses the recipient's positive reaction as evidence rather than assuming that the same frame color would suit everyone. For a later gift or replacement, [X] compares understated, high-contrast, metallic, and transparent frame colors against that person's usual clothes and checks the choice with the recipient before treating a currently popular color as a stable preference.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 朋友喜欢通过穿搭表达自己，[X]据此在生日时送出一副流行款太阳镜，并把朋友收到后确实喜欢的反馈作为依据，而不把同一种镜框颜色泛化给所有人；此后再次选礼物或替换眼镜时，[X]会结合对方平日着装比较低调色、高对比色、金属色和透明色，并先向对方确认，再把当下流行的颜色视为稳定偏好。
examples: using Black, Brown, Gray, or Clear when the recipient confirms a quieter frame that repeats easily with daily clothes
using Red, Orange, Green, Blue, Purple, Pink, or Yellow only when visible self-expression is part of the confirmed recipient fit
using Silver or Gold when the recipient prefers a metallic accent rather than inferring it from popularity alone

scenarios.scenario_abstract: For a clear-weather afternoon campus reunion, [X] builds an outfit from an existing closet around a sweater, dark jeans, and familiar casual footwear, then considers sunglasses as the final optional layer and judges whether their frame color preserves approachability or makes the outfit feel too styled.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 准备在晴朗的下午参加校园同学会时，[X]会从现有衣橱中搭配毛衣、深色牛仔裤和熟悉的休闲鞋，再把太阳镜作为最后的可选配饰，判断镜框颜色会保持亲切感，还是让整体显得过度造型。
examples: using a subdued frame when the user wants to remain close to his usual appearance
trying a more visible frame only if it does not overpower the informal campus setting
leaving the sunglasses out if no candidate supports the intended degree of polish

scenarios.scenario_abstract: Before fixing the season for a Mumbai trip, [X] plans to bring one versatile pair of sunglasses that must work with light clothing, religious-site cover-ups, heat, humidity, and a limited set of repeated travel outfits, then chooses a frame color compatible with all those combinations.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 在确定孟买旅行的季节之前，[X]会计划只带一副通用太阳镜，使其配合轻薄服装、宗教场所遮盖层、炎热潮湿天气以及有限的重复旅行穿搭，再选择能够贯穿这些组合的镜框颜色。
examples: choosing a frame that can repeat across changing seasonal packing lists
checking whether a quiet, warm, metallic, vivid, or transparent-looking edge integrates with the small wardrobe
waiting for exact dates before treating any seasonal suggestion as a final purchase
